title: Remote `podman secret ls` ignores errors
body:
### Issue Description

in the `ContainerEngine.SecretList` function (`pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/secrets.go:53`) the returned error from `secrets.List` is discarded and error is always `nil`. So for example if invalid filter is passed an empty list is returned while it's expected to see an error message.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Run podman as an API service: `podman system service --time=0 tcp://localhost:8282`
2. Create a new secret (otherwise no error for invalid error will be returned): `echo "my-secret" | podman secret create secret1 -`
3. Run podman not remotely to see the error message: `podman secret ls --filter invalid=blabla; echo $?`
4. Run podman remotely: `podman --remote --url tcp://localhost:8282 secret ls --filter invalid=blabla; echo $?`

### Describe the results you received

ID          NAME        DRIVER      CREATED     UPDATED
0


### Describe the results you expected

Error: invalid filter "invalid"
125
